claims.claim: In the 24 pinned module inputs, 13 literal-zero words at export-pointer positions are each exact .rel.text relocation sites with r_info type R_MIPS_32 and symbol index zero.
The old literal parser stops at those relocated zero words, hiding 450 later export entries; continuing through only those relocation-backed zeros produces 746 entries versus 296 literal entries.
The independently computed list of 13 zero export sites matches the pinned relocation-aware crosswalk result by module SHA-256 and site offset.
A zero pointer with R_MIPS_32 symbol zero becomes the explicitly chosen synthetic base in the current byte model; this does not prove the runtime base or export API meaning.

disposition: Judgment supports the bounded interpretation only. Deterministic ELF site arithmetic and hash-matched cross-check are the proof; runtime loading, API semantics, and binding remain unproved.
